notes: Physical/repairable remains much larger than immediately combat-serviceable because cratered runways, damaged fuel/communications and repair queues dominate.
Water-air/recon retains disproportionate warning value after runway suppression but lagoon ramps/tenders/fuel have also been repeatedly attacked.
No 6-8 Kinsei late-Jan order is credited as Marshall combat reinforcement; it is held farther west after the air situation collapses.
operational_state: Residual local defense/harassment and reporting only; incapable of stopping division-scale landings or contesting US air superiority.
